title: MV Check for User's Mouse Position?

posts.author: luckier123
posts.body:
I'm interested in making a point-and-click style RPG Maker MV game. But I'm trying to figure out how to run a check for the player's mouse X and Y position?
I want to make a button (using Show Picture command) that glows when you're hovering over it, and then responds when you click on it. But I'm not sure how to check for when the mouse is hovering over that particular area. Can this be accomplished in a script?
I'm new to Javascript coding so if anyone has an idea I'd appreciate it - thanks!

posts.author: rpgLord69
cuebitcrush
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
But I think for hover you can also just store the coordinates without the click in the mouse method (copy paste to notepad, save as .js file and add as a plugin). Then you can check TouchInput._hoverX and TouchInput._hoverY in a script.
